events.title: 리버풀's hopes of retaining their league title are damaged by a 1–0 away defeat to 사우샘프턴.
아스널 are five points ahead at the top of the First Division with seven games remaining after a 5–0 home win over 애스턴 빌라.
아스널 take a step closer to the title by beating 셰필드 유나이티드 2–0 at Bramall Lane .
크리스털 팰리스 win the Full Members Cup after a 4–1 victory over 에버턴 in the Wembley final.

리버풀's title challenge is kept alive with a thrilling 5–4 away win over 리즈 유나이티드, but the Reds are five points behind 아스널 with five games left. Leeds striker Lee Chapman finds himself in the unusual position of scoring a hat-trick despite being on the losing side.

토트넘 홋스퍼 end 아스널's hopes of the double and boost their own hopes of an eighth FA Cup triumph with a 3–1 win in the first FA Cup semi-final to be played at Wembley. 노팅엄 포리스트 win the other semi-final, crushing 웨스트햄 유나이티드 4–0 at Villa Park .
Graeme Souness is named as 리버풀's new manager, departing from 레인저스, where he is succeeded by Walter Smith .

노팅엄 포리스트 record the biggest First Division win of the season by beating 첼시 7–0 at the City Ground . 더비 카운티 lose to 맨체스터 시티 and are relegated. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 seal promotion back to the First Division two years after relegation by beating Swindon 2–0 at Upton Park, with five games left to play in the Second Division.
셰필드 웬즈데이, chasing promotion to the First Division, achieve a 1–0 win over 맨체스터 유나이티드 in the League Cup final to end a 56-year trophy drought.
David White scores four goals for 맨체스터 시티 in a 5–2 away win over 애스턴 빌라. With three games to go, the title race remains open as both 아스널 and 리버풀 win and the gap remains three points wide.

April draws to a close with 아스널 three points ahead of 리버풀 with three matches left, while 크리스털 팰리스's title dreams have ended. 선덜랜드, 루턴 타운 and last season's runners-up 애스턴 빌라 still fighting to avoid relegation alongside 더비 카운티.
